tutorials.name: Basics: The City at Night
tutorials.blurb: Controls, Districts and Citizens, playing units, Hunting, Intercepts, the Toll and claiming a District.

steps.say: Welcome to NIGHTFALL. Two monsters race to claim a City of five Districts, the cards in the middle row, before Dawn. You play the Zombie Horde (bottom); the Blood Cabal sits across from you (top).
Each District shows its Citizens. Citizens are what everyone hunts. When a District has none left, it Falls at the Toll and someone claims it. Claim 3 Districts to win.
Your resource is Biomass (shown by your name). Glowing cards can be played: tap one to play it, then tap where it goes. A long press on any card shows it up close.
Play Sprinter into Old Town: tap Sprinter, then tap Old Town on the board, then Confirm.
Units Hunt by exhausting. Sprinter is Swift, so it can Hunt the turn it arrives. Tap Sprinter and choose Prey to take a Citizen. Zombies Infect: the Citizen rises as your Shambler.
Old Town now has a Shambler and one fewer Citizen. Play Fresh Turned into Old Town too.
A Vampire is lurking in the Subway. Play Hazmat Shambler there to stand guard.
New units arrive Fresh: they can move to a neighbouring District, but they can't Hunt until your next turn unless they are Swift. That is all for this Night.
Tap End phase. Your Toll comes next, then your opponent's turn.
Your opponent's Vampire is Preying in the Subway. Your Hazmat Shambler is ready there, so you may Intercept: the Prey becomes a Clash between the two units instead.
Tap Hazmat Shambler and choose Intercept.
Then tap Pass to let the Clash happen.

In a Clash both units deal their Menace (the dagger) to each other at once, as wounds. Wounds equal to Endurance (the heart) destroy a unit. The Vampire fell; Hazmat prevents its first wound each turn. Every death also feeds your Morgue: +1 Biomass.
A new turn. At Rise your units ready again. Spread: with 3 or more Zombies in a District, you Infect a Citizen there at every Rise. Old Town just lost another Citizen to it.
Prey with Sprinter in Old Town.
Prey with Fresh Turned too. It is no longer Fresh.
Old Town is empty. At your Toll, an empty District Falls to whoever has the most Dominion there: the total Menace of their units (plus structures). That is you.
End your Night to claim Old Town.

Old Town is yours: it turns to its Fallen side and gives you a bonus. You win by claiming 3 Districts, by bringing the rival Master to 0 Essence with Strikes, or by your faction's signature victory. At Dawn (after 5 AM on the Night Track) the most Districts wins. Try a faction tutorial next.

tutorials.name: Blood Cabal: Old Money
tutorials.blurb: Feed and Thralls, Vitae, Influence and Domination, Drain, and answering on your opponent's turn with a Fast Scheme.

steps.say: The Blood Cabal already owns the City. You pay with Vitae, keep fed humans as Thralls (each adds Vitae at Gather), and take Districts by buying them, not emptying them.
Old Money makes your first Influence each turn 1 cheaper. Raise Blood Bank Holdings in the Campground.
Play Velvet Rope Fledgling (Swift) into the Campground.
Prey with it. The Cabal Feeds: the Citizen becomes a Thrall and you gain 2 Vitae.

Domination is your signature claim: at your Toll, if your Influence in a District is at least its remaining Citizens, you take them all and claim it, whatever anyone's Dominion. The Campground has 2 Citizens; your Influence there is 1.
Councilman Doyle counts as 2 Influence. Play him into the Campground.
Drain turns a Thrall back into 2 Vitae whenever you need it. Tap your Master and choose Drain a Thrall.
Remember Thirst: at each Rise, every Vampire costs Vitae (1, or 2 for Elders). An unpaid Vampire Frenzies and must Hunt.
End your Night. At your Toll, 3 Influence beats 2 Citizens.
Dominated: the Campground and its Citizens are yours. Now your opponent's turn begins.
They are playing Containment Breach. The Cabal is the only faction with Fast Schemes, which you may play on your opponent's turn.
Play A Quiet Word with the Mayor to cancel it.
Then Pass.
Cancelled: their card goes to the Grave and they draw a replacement. Feed, hold Influence and keep a Scheme ready: that is the Cabal. Domination wins games before Dawn.

tutorials.name: Harvest Cult: The Wheel Turns
tutorials.blurb: The Wheel of the Year, Plantings and Yields, Folk and Fae, Effigies, Offerings and the Old One's Harvest.

steps.say: The Harvest Cult lives by the Wheel of the Year. At each of your Rises it turns: Sowing (first Planting free), Growing (Plantings grow faster), Reaping (Plantings Yield and Folk may Prey), Fallow (heal, draw extra, keep at most 2 Bounty). It is Reaping now.
Your Blood Barley in the Field ripened (Growth 2) and Yielded 3 Bounty at Gather. And because the Barrow held 10 Offerings at Rise, He Who Wears the Hill awoke at your Scarecrow in Old Town.
Folk are Mortals and may only Prey in Reaping. Prey with the Hollow-Eyed Farmhand at the Docks: the Citizen becomes an Offering in your Barrow.
Fae Horrors Prey in any season. Play The Little People at the Docks.
Effigies are structures with Dominion; enemies must Raid them. Raise The Standing Stone at the Docks.
At each of your Reaping Tolls, the Old One Harvests its District: every Citizen becomes an Offering and the District is yours, whatever the Dominion.
End your Night and let it Harvest Old Town.
Old Town is Harvested and claimed. Next comes Fallow: rest, draw and spend down your Bounty. Plant on Sowing, protect on Growing, strike on Reaping. Your opponent can see the Wheel too.

tutorials.name: Zombie Horde: Outbreak
tutorials.blurb: Infect and Devour, Spread, the Morgue and sacrifices, Strains and Mutations, and Overrun.

steps.say: The Zombie Horde never buys anything. It eats. Biomass comes from Gather, from the Morgue (+1 whenever any unit dies) and from your own Shamblers.
Spread: you had 3 Zombies in the Subway at Rise, so a Citizen there was Infected and rose as a Shambler.
Prey with Sprinter in the Subway: named Zombies Infect, adding another Shambler.
Bodies are currency. Sacrifice a Shambler for Biomass: +1 for the sacrifice, +1 from the Morgue, and +1 because Patient Zero feeds on his own.
Strains upgrade every Zombie you have. Install LAZARUS-7: your Shamblers get +1 Menace.
Mutations upgrade one Zombie. Attach Chitin Plating to the Hazmat Shambler (+3 Endurance and Guard).

Overrun: at your Toll, if your Zombies in a District number at least twice its remaining Citizens and no enemy units are there, you Infect them all and claim it. The Subway has 1 Citizen and 4 of your Zombies.
End your Night to Overrun the Subway.
The Subway is overrun. Keep 3 Zombies together and the Horde snowballs, but watch for area damage like Molotov Cocktail, and keep a defender home: your Master has only 18 Essence.

tutorials.name: Slasher Killers: Don't Go in There
tutorials.blurb: Lurking face down, bluffs and Traps, revealing a Killer, Slay and Panic, Vanish, and the Body Count.

steps.say: The Slashers are a few legends that won't stay dead. Your opponent sees only face-down cards and must guess which one is the Killer. You need 13 Victims: you have 11.
Once per turn you may Lurk: place any card from your hand face down in a District, free. Lurk the Bear Trap in Old Town, next to their Hellhound.
Your face-down Groundskeeper waits at the Docks. You pay a Killer's cost only when you reveal it, and a Killer revealed to Hunt gets Ambush +2.
Reveal The Groundskeeper.
Prey with him. The Slashers Slay: the Citizen joins your Body Count and you gain Terror.
Then Panic: another Citizen flees to a neighbouring District of your choice (The Groundskeeper makes 2 flee).
Choose where the second Citizen flees.
12 Victims. At your Toll you may Vanish: pay 1 Terror to turn a revealed Killer face down again, and slip it to a neighbouring District.
End your Night.
Vanish The Groundskeeper.
Stay at the Docks or slip away: your choice.

On their turn, the Hellhound walked into Old Town and your Bear Trap sprang: 3 wounds, and it is gone. Traps cost their price only when they spring, and every spring pays you Terror. Any other card you Lurk is a bluff.
Reveal The Groundskeeper again.
Slay once more for the 13th Victim.
Thirteen. The Body Count is complete and the Slashers win. Beware the Final Girl: a Killer she destroys is Ended for good instead of returning as a Sequel.

tutorials.name: Devil's Own: Nine Moons
tutorials.blurb: The Vessel and Gestation, Omens and Portents, Bargains and Pacts, the Nativity and the Child.

steps.say: The Devil's Own race a visible clock: Gestation, from 0 to 9. It only moves while you control a Vessel, here Margaret Wells in Old Town, guarded by her Doting Neighbors. If the Vessel dies, Gestation halves.
Omens advance Gestation when their Portent comes true. It is midnight, the Witching Hour, so The Blood Moon was Fulfilled at your Rise: +3, now 8 of 9.
Bargains make your opponent choose. Play The Crossroads Deal: they Accept (draw 3 and take a Pact) or Refuse (you gain Sin and draw).
They accepted, so they carry a Pact. Each Pact pays you Sin at your Toll, and costs them 2 Essence when the Child is born.
Tithe of Souls is fulfilled by spending 3 Souls. Spend them now.
Gestation 9: the Nativity. The Child is born in the Vessel's District. If it is still in play at your next Rise, you win.
Disciples and Demons beside the Child gain Guard. Play a Hellhound into Old Town to wall it in.
End your Night and survive their turn.
The Child lived to see your Rise: the Prophecy is fulfilled and the Devil's Own win. Your opponent gets one turn to stop this every time, so protect the Vessel early and spread your Omens.
